She looks towards the camera and begins speaking with a playful expression. The room is well-lit with warm, bright indoor lighting. (2) The camera shifts slightly as she starts to laugh, her facial expressions becoming more animated and squinted. A second woman is partially visible in the background, sitting in a similar casual posture. The background features a modern wall decorated with a dense collage of small photos and magnets. (3) The camera pans to focus on the second woman, who is wearing a white t-shirt with 'SEVENTIES' printed on it. She is holding a white tissue over her nose and mouth, laughing so hard that her body shakes. She occasionally gestures with her hands as she tries to compose herself. (4) Both women are seen in a wider shot as they both succumb to infectious laughter. The woman in the cream shirt is now holding a smartphone and laughing uncontrollably along with her companion, who is bent over forward while still clutching the tissue to her face.
